header: Every module in the Vertex Supply platform
subheadline: Five modules on a single licence, switched on per team as you need them. Swipe through to see what each one owns, or start with the two that most companies enable in week one: Dispatch and Field.

items.title: Dispatch
items.description: The scheduling board: skills, certifications, distance and SLA clocks in one view, refreshing in a median of 1.8 seconds.

items.title: Field
items.description: The technician app. Job sheets, photos, parts and signatures, cached for seven days so a basement plant room is no obstacle.

items.title: Assets
items.description: Every serviced unit with its serial number, warranty end date, QR label and complete visit history in one register.

items.title: Portal
items.description: Customers see their own open calls, planned maintenance dates and signed job sheets without emailing your service desk.

items.title: Insights
items.description: Contract profitability, first-time fix rate and travel time per technician, exported weekly to your reporting stack.
